The BHTune Windows installer can install opcda-bridge-gateway 0.6.1 as an
optional companion component.

Project: https://github.com/bytehound-labs/opcda-bridge
Release: opcda-bridge-gateway-v0.6.1
Source commit: c21cd193e1b15fe46339481975676150f4609f0b
License: MIT

The embedded executable is copied from the official upstream release archive
and is not rebuilt or modified by BHTune. The installer build verifies the
upstream checksum, Sigstore identity, GitHub provenance, archive contents,
32-bit PE architecture, reported version, and required protocol versions before
packaging it.
